q23180.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T goes through first.

explain.short: T is a tram. Here the vehicle on rails has priority over the cars, so it goes first.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before cars here. Without signs, give way to vehicles from your right; two vehicles go together if their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): the tram is first, before L, A and C.

sceneParams.caption: Tram T first, then L and A, then C

q23181.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles go through in this order: T, L and A, finally C.

explain.short: The tram T goes first. Then L and A go together: their paths do not cross. C goes last, because L comes from its right.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before cars here. Without signs, give way to vehicles from your right; two vehicles go together if their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'L ed A' means L and A at the same time; 'infine' (finally) means C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Order: T, then L and A together, then C

q23182.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: C, A, L, R, E.

explain.short: Each vehicle waits for the one on its right. C has nobody on its right that crosses its path, so the chain is C, A, L, R, E.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'nel seguente ordine' (in this order): all five letters must be in the right place, and they are.

sceneParams.caption: Order: C, A, L, R, E

q23183.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C goes through first.

explain.short: On C's right there is only E, and E goes straight without crossing C's path. So C does not wait for anyone and goes first.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): C starts, even if E is on its right, because their paths do not cross.

sceneParams.caption: C goes first: nobody on its right crosses it

q23184.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes through immediately after vehicle C.

explain.short: C is on A's right, so A waits only for C. As soon as C has gone, A goes.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'subito dopo' (immediately after): A is second, right after C.

sceneParams.caption: A goes second, right after C

q23185.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E must give way to vehicles R and L.

explain.short: R is on E's right, and R must itself wait for L. So E waits for both of them and goes last.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way): E is last, so it lets R and L go first.

sceneParams.caption: E waits for L and R and goes last

q23186.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes through before vehicle L.

explain.short: A is on L's right, so L waits for A.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'prima del' (before): A is second, L is third.

sceneParams.caption: A (2nd) goes before L (3rd)

q23187.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L goes through before vehicle R.

explain.short: L is on R's right, so R waits for L.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'prima del' (before): L is third, R is fourth.

sceneParams.caption: L (3rd) goes before R (4th)

q23188.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle L goes through after vehicle A.

explain.short: A is on L's right, so L must wait until A has gone.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after): L is third, after A, which is second.

sceneParams.caption: L goes after A

q23189.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: A turns towards the right-hand road and E goes straight to the left: their paths do not cross. E gives way to R and L, not to A.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo A': E does give way, but to R and L; A is not in its way.

sceneParams.caption: E waits for R and L, not for A

q23190.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles must go through in this order: E, C, A, L, R.

explain.short: E cannot go first: R is on its right. E goes last; the right order is C, A, L, R, E.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'E, C, A, L, R' puts E first, but E is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E is last, not first

q23191.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A must wait for vehicle E to pass.

explain.short: A's path does not cross E's path, and A goes second, long before E, which is last.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): A does not wait for E; it waits only for C.

sceneParams.caption: A goes 2nd; E goes last

q23192.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, any vehicle may enter the junction and stop in the middle of it.

explain.short: Nobody may enter a junction and stop in the middle: it blocks the others. Each vehicle enters in its turn, only when it can cross completely.
explain.rule: Enter a junction only in your turn and only when you can get out the other side. Never stop in the middle of it.
explain.trap: 'qualunque veicolo' (any vehicle) and 'fermarsi al centro' (stop in the middle): this is never allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Never stop in the middle of the junction

q23193.en: To cross the junction shown in the picture, vehicles C and R go through at the same time after vehicle A has passed.

explain.short: C goes first, before A. R goes only fourth, after L. They never go together.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time): C is first and R is fourth.

sceneParams.caption: No: C is 1st, R is 4th, not together

q23194.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles leave the junction in this order: A, E, V, H, C.

explain.short: A goes first: nobody on its right crosses its path. Then each one follows the one on its right: E, V, H, and C last.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'disimpegnano l'incrocio' (leave the junction) in this order: every letter is in the right place.

sceneParams.caption: Order: A, E, V, H, C

q23195.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle V has priority over vehicle H.

explain.short: V comes from H's right, so H must wait for V.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority): V is on H's right, so V goes first.

sceneParams.caption: V (3rd) has priority over H (4th)

q23196.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle C must give way to vehicle H.

explain.short: H comes from C's right and their paths cross, so C waits for H. C goes last.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way): C gives way because H is on its right.

sceneParams.caption: C waits for H and goes last

q23197.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle E goes before vehicle H.

explain.short: E is second; H is fourth, after V. So E goes before H.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'prima del' (before): E is 2nd, H is 4th.

sceneParams.caption: E (2nd) goes before H (4th)

q23198.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle H goes after vehicles A, E, V.

explain.short: H has V on its right, and V waits for E, who waits for A. So H is fourth, after A, E and V.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'dopo i veicoli A, E, V' (after A, E, V): H is fourth, only C is after it.

sceneParams.caption: H goes 4th, after A, E and V

q23199.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A goes first.

explain.short: A turns left into the top road, and the only vehicle on its right (C) does not cross its path. So A starts the chain.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): A is first because no vehicle on its right is in its way.

sceneParams.caption: A goes first

q23200.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles leave the junction in this order: A, H, C, E, V.

explain.short: H cannot go second: V is on its right, and V waits for E. The right order is A, E, V, H, C.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'A, H, C, E, V': A is right, but then the order is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: after A comes E, then V, H, C

q23201.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles leave the junction in this order: A, E, C, V, H.

explain.short: C cannot be third: H is on its right, so C goes last. The right order is A, E, V, H, C.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'A, E, C, V, H': C is placed too early.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C is last, after H

q23202.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle V must wait until vehicles A, E, H have passed.

explain.short: V waits for A and E, but not for H: V is on H's right, so H waits for V.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'A, E, H': the trap is H; it is H that waits for V.

sceneParams.caption: V waits for A and E, not for H

q23203.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicles A, V and C go at the same time.

explain.short: They go one after the other: A is first, V third and C last.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time): here every vehicle goes alone, one by one.

sceneParams.caption: No: A 1st, V 3rd, C last

q23204.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle V goes after vehicles C and H.

explain.short: V goes third, before H (fourth) and C (last). H waits for V, because V is on its right.
explain.rule: There are no signs, so each driver gives way to vehicles coming from the right. You wait only for vehicles whose path you would cross.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after): it is the opposite; V goes before C and H.

sceneParams.caption: No: V goes before H and C

q23205.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicles L and H go first at the same time.

explain.short: L and H are on the main road (B and O have a give-way sign). They go straight and their paths do not cross, so they go together.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente per primi' (together, first): yes, both are on the main road.

sceneParams.caption: L and H first together, then B, then O

q23206.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go in this order: L and H, B, O.

explain.short: L and H (main road) go together first. Then B, which turns right. O turns left and must also let B pass, so O is last.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'L e H, B, O': L and H together, then B, then O, which is right.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L and H, then B, then O

q23207.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B goes through after vehicles L and H.

explain.short: B has a give-way sign, so it waits for L and H on the main road.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'dopo i veicoli L e H' (after L and H): yes, B must give way to them.

sceneParams.caption: B waits for L and H (give way)

q23208.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle O goes through last.

explain.short: O has a give-way sign and turns left, so it also lets B (coming from the opposite side) go first. O is last.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, O waits for everyone.

sceneParams.caption: O goes last

q23209.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle B goes through before vehicle O and after vehicles L and H.

explain.short: B is in the middle: it waits for L and H (main road), but goes before O, which turns left.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: Two parts, both right: 'prima del veicolo O' (before O) and 'dopo i veicoli L e H' (after L and H).

sceneParams.caption: B: after L and H, before O

keywords.it: dopo i veicoli L e H

q23210.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle O must give way to all the other vehicles.

explain.short: O has a give-way sign (so it waits for L and H) and turns left (so it waits for B too). It gives way to everybody.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'a tutti gli altri' (to all the others): yes, O is last.

sceneParams.caption: O gives way to everyone

q23211.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle O goes through before vehicle H, but after vehicle L.

explain.short: O is last. H goes first, together with L, on the main road.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo H' (before H) is wrong: H and L go together, first.

sceneParams.caption: No: O is last; H goes with L first

q23212.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle O goes through before vehicle H, but after vehicle B.

explain.short: O is after B, but it is not before H: H goes first, together with L. O is last.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo H' (before H) is the wrong half; 'dopo il veicolo B' alone would be right.

sceneParams.caption: No: O is last, after H too

q23213.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle B goes through first.

explain.short: B has a give-way sign, so it must wait for L and H on the main road.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): B is second, after L and H.

sceneParams.caption: No: B gives way to L and H first

q23214.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle H goes through after vehicle O.

explain.short: H is on the main road and goes first; O has a give-way sign and goes last.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo O' (after O): it is the opposite.

sceneParams.caption: No: H goes first, O last

q23215.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go in this order: B, L, O, H.

explain.short: B and O have a give-way sign, so they cannot go before L and H. The right order is L and H, then B, then O.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'B, L, O, H' puts the give-way vehicles too early.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L and H first, then B, then O

q23216.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle O enters the junction first and stops in the middle of it.

explain.short: O has a give-way sign and turns left: it goes last. Nobody may enter a junction and stop in the middle of it.
explain.rule: A give-way sign (triangle, shark teeth on the road) means: let everyone on the other road pass. A driver turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'impegna l'incrocio per primo' (enters first) and 'si ferma al centro' (stops in the middle): both are wrong.

sceneParams.caption: No: O goes last; never stop in the middle

q23217.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle S goes through before vehicle R.

explain.short: S is on the main road; R has a give-way sign. So S goes before R.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo R' (before R): yes, S is first and R is last.

sceneParams.caption: S (1st) before R (last)

q23218.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle S goes through before all the other vehicles.

explain.short: S is on the main road and goes straight. A, also on the main road, turns left and waits for S. E and R have a give-way sign.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'prima di tutti gli altri' (before all the others): yes, S is first.

sceneParams.caption: S goes first of all

keywords.it: prima di tutti gli altri veicoli

q23219.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in the order: S, A, E, R.

explain.short: Main road first: S (straight), then A (turning left). Then the give-way road: E (straight), then R (turning left).
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'nell'ordine: S, A, E, R' (in the order): every letter is in the right place.

sceneParams.caption: Order: S, A, E, R

q23220.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must give way to vehicle S.

explain.short: A and S are both on the main road, facing each other. A turns left, so it lets S, going straight, pass first.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza' (must give way): yes, the one turning left waits for the oncoming one.

sceneParams.caption: A turns left and waits for S

q23221.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R goes through last.

explain.short: R has a give-way sign, so it waits for S and A. It also turns left, so it waits for E coming the other way. R is last.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, R waits for everybody.

sceneParams.caption: R goes last

q23222.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle E must wait for vehicle R to pass.

explain.short: E and R both have a give-way sign and face each other. R turns left, so R waits for E, not the other way round.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): it is R that waits for E.

sceneParams.caption: No: R turns left and waits for E

q23223.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R enters the junction first and stops in the middle of it.

explain.short: R has a give-way sign and turns left: it goes last. Nobody may enter a junction and stop in the middle of it.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'impegna per primo' (enters first) and 'si ferma al centro' (stops in the middle): both are wrong.

sceneParams.caption: No: R goes last; never stop in the middle

q23224.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must go through after vehicle E.

explain.short: A is on the main road; E has a give-way sign. So A goes before E (A is second, E third).
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo E' (after E): it is the opposite.

sceneParams.caption: No: A (2nd) goes before E (3rd)

q23225.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must go through last.

explain.short: A is on the main road: it waits only for S. It goes second, before E and R.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): A is second; R is last.

sceneParams.caption: No: A is 2nd; R is last

q23226.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in the order: E, R, S, A.

explain.short: E and R have a give-way sign, so they cannot go before S and A. The right order is S, A, E, R.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'E, R, S, A' puts the give-way road first: it is upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: main road first; S, A, E, R

q23227.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must wait until vehicles S and E have passed.

explain.short: A waits only for S. E has a give-way sign, so E waits for A.
explain.rule: Vehicles on the main road go first; a give-way sign means wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle going straight pass first.
explain.trap: 'S ed E': S is right, but E is the trap; A does not wait for E.

sceneParams.caption: No: A waits for S only; E waits for A

q23228.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle A must wait for vehicles C and R to pass.

explain.short: A has a give-way sign, so it waits for C and R, which are on the main road.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, A gives way to the main road.

sceneParams.caption: A waits for C and R (main road)

q23229.en: In the situation shown in the picture, the vehicles go through in the order: C, R, A, H.

explain.short: Main road first: C, then R (turning left, it waits for C). Then A (straight) and H last (A is on its right).
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'nell'ordine: C, R, A, H' (in the order): every letter is in the right place.

sceneParams.caption: Order: C, R, A, H

q23230.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H must wait for vehicles C, R, A to pass.

explain.short: H has a give-way sign (so it waits for C and R) and A comes from its right (so it waits for A too).
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'C, R, A': yes, H waits for all three and goes last.

sceneParams.caption: H waits for C, R and A

q23231.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H must go through last.

explain.short: H has a give-way sign and A comes from its right; H also turns left. So H goes last.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last): yes, H waits for everyone.

sceneParams.caption: H goes last

q23232.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle R must wait for vehicle C to pass.

explain.short: R and C are both on the main road, facing each other. R turns left off it, so it lets C pass first.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): yes, the one turning left waits for the oncoming one.

sceneParams.caption: R turns left and waits for C

q23233.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C goes through first.

explain.short: C is on the main road and follows it around the bend. Nobody has priority over C, so it goes first.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): yes; the big truck C is on the main road.

sceneParams.caption: C goes first along the main road

q23234.en: In the situation shown in the picture, the vehicles go through in the order: C, R, H, A.

explain.short: C and R are right, but H cannot go before A: A comes from H's right. The right order is C, R, A, H.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'C, R, H, A': the last two are swapped.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes before H

q23235.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C must wait for vehicle H to pass.

explain.short: C is on the main road and goes first; H has a give-way sign and goes last.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): it is H that waits for C.

sceneParams.caption: No: C goes first, H last

q23236.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle A must wait for vehicle H to pass.

explain.short: A and H both have a give-way sign. A comes from H's right, so H waits for A, not the other way round.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): it is H that waits for A.

sceneParams.caption: No: A is on H's right; H waits

q23237.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle R must wait for vehicles H and A to pass.

explain.short: R is on the main road; H and A have a give-way sign. R waits only for C, then goes before H and A.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'H ed A': they are the ones who wait for R.

sceneParams.caption: No: R waits only for C

q23238.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C must wait for vehicles R, A, H to pass.

explain.short: C is on the main road and goes straight along it: it goes first and waits for nobody.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): C is first, the others wait for C.

sceneParams.caption: No: C goes first, waits for nobody

q23239.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle R must wait for vehicle H to pass.

explain.short: R is on the main road; H has a give-way sign and goes last. R waits only for C.
explain.rule: The main road can bend: its vehicles go first and the give-way roads wait. A driver turning left lets the oncoming vehicle pass; among the waiting roads, give way to the right.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait): it is H that waits for R.

sceneParams.caption: No: R (2nd) goes before H (last)

q23240.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle T goes through first.

explain.short: T is a tram. With no signs, the vehicle on rails has priority over vehicles without rails, so it goes first.
explain.rule: Without signs, a tram (vehicle on rails) goes before the other vehicles. Between cars, give way to the vehicle coming from your right.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first): yes, the tram is first.

sceneParams.caption: Tram T first, then O, then A

explain.rule: Without signs, a tram (vehicle on rails) goes before the other vehicles. Between cars, give way to the vehicle coming from your right.

q23248.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go through in the order: T, A, O.

q23249.en: According to the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicles A and T go through at the same time.

explain.short: The tram T goes first. A must wait for O (on its right), and O must wait for T. So A goes last, not together with T.
explain.rule: Without signs, a tram (vehicle on rails) goes before the other vehicles. Between cars, give way to the vehicle coming from your right.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time): A cannot go with the tram, because it must let O pass first.
